reviewer: Claude (owner-requested addition of 日本庭園前), with the owner's on-site pole photograph
scope: Feed-only timetable v3 adding 日本庭園前 (Nihon Teien-mae) in both Kintetsu directions. All other data is the 2026-10-01 reviewed baseline.
findings: Official pole sheets 2022_hankyuibaraki ([12][22] to JR Ibaraki / Hankyu Ibaraki-shi, revised 2024-08-21) and 2022_handai ([24][25] to Handai hospital, revised 2025-12-21) were fetched from kintetsu-bus.co.jp on 2026-10-02.
The owner's photograph of the JR-bound pole (sheet code 2022-2, revised 2024-08-21) matches the official sheet: weekday 84, Saturday 52, Sunday/holiday 45 departures, identical minutes.

Every 日本庭園前 cell in the weekday, Saturday and Sunday/holiday line matrices (kintetsu_2/3/4, rows 15 and 28) maps to exactly one departure; every pole minute and marker maps to exactly one matrix departure.

Route 12 appears twice on weekdays only: 7:20 is printed on the Handai-bound row but the bus starts here for Ibaraki (next 南春日丘西 7:21); it is boarded at the Ibaraki pole, as the pole sheet and the owner's photo show. 21:03 arrives from Hankyu Ibaraki-shi and terminates here; it is not a departure.
Pole legend: ★ = [25] via Handai hospital/Honbu to Ibaraki Mihogaoka; ▲ = [25] via Ibaraki Mihogaoka to the Handai stops; unmarked = [24] to Handai Honbu.
Kintetsu notices changed after 2026-10-01 only for a hiring post and a June 2026 Tondabayashi-area timetable change; no Ibaraki-line revision.

Coordinates: Kintetsu's Jorudan map gives only a stop centre with an empty pole list. The two OpenStreetMap platforms (nodes 9229774649 and 9229774657) each sit beside a one-way carriageway whose left-hand direction matches the boarding direction. They are recorded as community_mapped_corroborated, not operator pole records.
